1. Open the [admission portal](https://admission.gcdharamshala.in/).
2. Choose UG or PG and general or professional registration.
3. Select programme and year or semester.
4. Complete registration with your own valid contact details.
5. After login, select subjects if applicable.
6. Monitor merit lists and counselling messages. Bring originals and copies if called for counselling.

Selection requirements vary by course.

**Official source:** [View details](https://admission.gcdharamshala.in/)
Admission dates vary by programme and session. Read current announcements at https://admission.gcdharamshala.in/ and https://gcdharamshala.in/all-post/.
